extracted.name: Sheet Pan Vegan Roasted Eggplant with Garlic
extracted.description: This delicious roasted eggplant, seasoned with garlic and smoked paprika, is a simple vegan side dish made in a sheet pan in just minutes.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place eggplant slices in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil; sprinkle with garlic powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning.
Roast in the preheated oven until golden and crispy, about 25 minutes. Sprinkle with salt.
